labels: One arm extends toward the upper shelf, with open fingertips stopping just below a specific book's lower spine while the other hand steadies the shelf edge.; 한 팔이 윗선반으로 뻗고 열린 손끝이 특정 책 등 아래에서 멈추며 다른 손은 선반 가장자리를 짚는다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: One arm extends toward the upper shelf, with open fingertips stopping just below a specific book's lower spine while the other hand steadies the shelf edge.
